manifest.name: GNU basename live reconstruction
manifest.description: Investigate an installed native utility and reconstruct its unbounded path-processing behavior using real model inference, independent executable checks and automated project governance.

blocks.title: Reconstruct GNU basename directly
blocks.instructions: Investigate /usr/bin/basename through local commands and implement its general algorithmic path-processing behavior. Produce artifact.files[main.ts] as a portable Node.js TypeScript CLI (Node22.18+); handle -a/--multiple, -s/--suffix and --suffix=, -z/--zero, combined short options, -- separator, optional single-operand suffix, empty paths, trailing slashes, slash-only paths, errors, arbitrary Unicode strings. Match stdout and exit status. No external commands or dependencies in generated code; no lookup tables. Exact stderr wording, --help and --version are outside the contract.

payload.reason: Automatic policy: locally executed pinned verifier basename-parity

payload.summary: Reconstructed the CLI and matched stdout bytes and exit status in 11 differential checks against `/usr/bin/basename`. The installed reference stops parsing options at the first operand, so `-a x -z` prints both `x` and `-z` with newline terminators. Verification used Node 26.13.0 in memory. Node 22.18 was not independently tested.
